title: Noetherian approximation of a relative global complete intersection
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,c\ge0$ integers and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that $R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. Then there is a subring $R_0\subseteq R$ which is a finite type $\mathbf Z$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] (that is, generated as a ring by finitely many elements) and contains all coefficients of $f_1,\dots,f_c$, such that, regarding $f_1,\dots,f_c$ as elements of $R_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]$, the ring $R_0[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection over $R_0$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00SU (lemma-relative-global-complete-intersection-Noetherian, algebra.tex line 36727) and its proof. Tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags (00SU,algebra-lemma-relative-global-complete-intersection-Noetherian)

proof.text: Construct R₀ as the ℤ-subalgebra generated by the finite union of the coefficient sets of fᵢ. FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite proves it finite type; mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset supplies f₀ with MvPolynomial.map R₀.subtype (f₀ i)=f i. The proof is the private finite_coefficient_model helper.

For every original prime q, apply the coefficient-model principal-neighbourhood theorem to get G(q), avoidance of q, and a bound n-c on each localized model fibre. Choose this family indexed by PrimeSpectrum S; choosing q itself witnesses the cover condition.

Apply bounded-principal-cover descent with d=n-c. This gives a finite type subring R₁, matching equations f₁, and for each nonzero descended fibre a bound n-c together with Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum S).

Map equality for f₁ implies the requested coefficient equality by coeff_map. For any nonzero descended fibre, select the original prime q supplied by the Nonempty clause. Its contraction to R gives a nonzero original fibre; the original presentation hypothesis therefore implies c ≤ n. Identify the descended fibre with the quotient by the residue-field equations using Presentation.naive.baseChange. Transfer nontriviality along this equivalence, apply the polynomial-quotient lower bound, and transfer the dimension along the induced homeomorphism. Antisymmetry with the upper bound proves dimension n-c. When no descended fibre is nonzero the presentation condition is vacuous.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteType_subring_relativeGlobalCompleteIntersection (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n c : ℕ) (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (h : IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f) : ∃ (R₀ : Subring R), Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R₀ ∧ ∃ (f₀ : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R₀), (∀ (i : Fin c) (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ), (MvPolynomial.coeff d (f i)) = (((MvPolynomial.coeff d (f₀ i)) : R₀) : R)) ∧ IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersectionPresentation f₀
